frequently_asked_questions.question: How can I get academic support?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Students can contact their respective academic department for support.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Where can I get examination-related help?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Students can contact the Examination Cell for examination-related information.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Where can I get placement-related help?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Students can contact the Training and Placement Cell for placement-related information.
